Lesson 2 · My Best Friend
Reading Adventure

My Best Friend

Lesson 2

Meet Ali and his best friend Omar! Read their story, learn 15 new words about friendship, and play fun games along the way. 👫

🎯 Learning Objectives

  • Learn 15 new vocabulary words
  • Read and understand a short story
  • Identify the main idea and important details
  • Answer reading comprehension questions
  • Identify nouns, verbs, adjectives, pronouns & prepositions
  • Arrange words to form correct sentences
  • Talk and write about a best friend
Warm Up

🗣️ Speaking Corner

Before we start, let's talk about friendship! Answer in complete sentences.

  • 👫 Who is your best friend?
  • 🤝 What do you like to do together?
  • 🎨 What is your friend's hobby?
  • ❤️ Why do you like your friend?

Before Reading

🔮 Predict the Story

Reading · Part 1 of 4

📖 My Best Friend

My best friend's name is Omar.

We are in the same class.

Omar is kind, funny, and helpful.

He always smiles and makes me laugh.

Reading · Part 2 of 4

📖 My Best Friend

We like to play football together during break time.

Reading · Part 3 of 4

📖 My Best Friend

Sometimes, we sit under a big tree and talk about our hobbies.

Omar likes drawing, but I like reading.

Reading · Part 4 of 4

📖 My Best Friend

We often share our books and pencils.

When I have a problem, Omar always helps me.

I can trust him because he is a good friend.

I am happy to have a best friend like Omar.
